name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship (RTF & MTF)
short_description: Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (RTF) and Maintenance Fee (MTF) for post-matric students of Telangana belonging to SC, ST, BC, EBC, and Minority categories.
administering_authority: Department of Backward Classes Welfare & Social Welfare, Government of Telangana
income_rule_description: SC/ST parental income limit is ₹2,00,000 p.a. BC/EBC/Minority students: Rural limit is ₹1,50,000 p.a., Urban limit is ₹2,00,000 p.a. Disabled category limit is ₹1,00,000 p.a.
academic_requirements: Minimum 75% attendance at the end of each quarter; admission secured through State Convenor Quota (CETs like TG EAMCET/ECET/ICET) for professional courses.
other_mandatory_criteria: Must be a bonafide domicile of Telangana state
Regular / full-time student (distance education / open university not eligible)
Parents must not be government employees with pensionable service
Must have an Aadhaar-seeded operational bank account
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the student
SSC Hall Ticket Number and Marks Memo
Latest Integrated Community/Caste Certificate (issued by Meeseva)
Latest Income Certificate issued by Meeseva on or after 1st April of current financial year
Bonafide / Study Certificate from the current institution
CET Allotment Order (for Convenor Quota)
College Fee Receipt
Bank Account Passbook (first page with IFSC and Aadhaar seeding status)
application_steps: Visit the official Telangana ePASS portal (telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in)
Click on 'Post Matric Scholarship Services' and select 'Fresh Registration'
Enter SSC details, Aadhaar number, and verify OTP
Fill in college admission, CET rank, course, and hostel details
Upload Meeseva Caste and Income certificate application numbers
Upload scanned copies of required documents
Submit application and take a printout of the acknowledgement
Submit physical hard copy with documents to college verification officer within 15 days
source_title: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
source_excerpt: Eligibility: Students belonging to SC, ST categories whose annual parental income is Rs. 2,00,000/- or less and BC, EBC, Minority Students belonging to rural area whose annual parental income is Rs. 1,50,000/- or less and Urban area Rs. 2,00,000/- or less. Disabled students whose parental income is Rs. 1,00,000/- or less. Minimum 75% attendance is required at the end of each quarter. Students pursuing correspondence courses are not eligible.
limitations: Applicable exclusively to students with Telangana domicile studying in recognized Telangana institutions or approved border institutes. Income certificate must be current year Meeseva issued.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
short_description: Annual scholarship of ₹50,000 per year for girl students admitted to AICTE approved technical degree or diploma courses.
administering_authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education, Govt of India
income_rule_description: Gross parental/family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000 (Rupees Eight Lakh) per annum.
academic_requirements: Candidate must be admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma course OR 2nd year through Lateral Entry in an AICTE approved technical institution via a centralized admission process.
other_mandatory_criteria: Maximum two girl children per family are eligible
Institution must be AICTE approved for the relevant academic year
Admission must be through Centralized Admission Process (CAP / State CET counselling)
required_documents: 10th and 12th / Diploma mark sheets
Annual Family Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar or competent revenue authority (<= ₹8 Lakh)
Admission Letter issued by Centralized Admission Authority to AICTE approved institution
Tuition fee receipt for the current academic year
Bank Account Passbook (in student's name, seeded with Aadhaar)
Affidavit on stamp paper declaring only two girl children in the family and family income
application_steps: Register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in
Complete Aadhaar / OTR (One Time Registration) authentication
Apply under AICTE schemes -> Pragati Scholarship Scheme (Degree or Diploma)
Provide student, course, fee, and institutional details
Upload verified income certificate and family affidavit
Submit application on NSP and track college-level verification
source_title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students Guidelines
source_excerpt: 1) The girl candidate should be admitted to First year of Degree/Diploma level course OR Second year of Degree/Diploma course through lateral entry in any of the AICTE approved Institution. 2) Maximum two girl child per family are eligible. 3) Family income from all sources should not be more than Rs. 8 lakh per annum during the preceding financial year.
limitations: Restricted to female candidates only. College must have AICTE approval for the specific branch and year.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS)
short_description: Merit-cum-means scholarship of ₹12,000/yr for graduation and ₹20,000/yr for post-graduation for top 20th percentile board scorers.
administering_authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India
income_rule_description: Gross parental/family annual income must not exceed ₹4,50,000 (Rupees Four Lakh Fifty Thousand) per annum.
academic_requirements: Scored above 80th percentile of successful candidates in relevant stream from respective Class 12th Board Examination; pursuing regular full-time degree course.
other_mandatory_criteria: Pursuing regular full-time course in recognized university/college (correspondence/distance mode strictly excluded)
Must NOT be receiving any other Central or State Government scholarship or fee reimbursement
Minimum 50% marks in annual college exams for yearly renewal
required_documents: Class 12th Marksheet indicating score above 80th percentile cutoff
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (<= ₹4.5 Lakh)
College Bonafide Certificate and Admission Receipt
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked for DBT transfer)
application_steps: Log into National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select Ministry of Education -> Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
Provide 12th board roll number and year of passing to auto-fetch merit eligibility
Upload verified income certificate and college bonafide letter
Submit and ensure college verification officer approves before deadline
source_title: Guidelines for Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
source_excerpt: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from a particular Board of Examination in Class XII of 10+2 pattern or equivalent and, having gross parental/family income not exceeding Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum, for pursuing regular courses (not correspondence or distance mode) from recognized educational institutions and not availing of any other scholarship scheme.
limitations: Strict exclusion: Student cannot hold any other scholarship simultaneously. Cutoff percentile varies each year by state board and stream.

name: PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education for OBC, EBC & DNT Students
short_description: Full tuition fee reimbursement and living allowance for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in notified premier institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, Central Universities).
administering_authority: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt of India
income_rule_description: Total family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (Rupees Two Lakh Fifty Thousand) per annum.
academic_requirements: Secured admission to one of the notified Top Class Institutions (e.g. IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, National Law Universities, Central Universities) as per institute admission guidelines.
other_mandatory_criteria: Must belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT)
Must be enrolled full-time in a notified premier institution
Must not be receiving scholarship under any other Central or State government scheme
required_documents: Valid OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EBC / DNT Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Family Income Certificate from Tehsildar (<= ₹2.5 Lakh p.a.)
Admission Offer Letter & Bonafide Certificate from notified institution
Fee receipt break-up of tuition and non-refundable fees
Aadhaar Card
Bank Account details seeded with Aadhaar
application_steps: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Navigate to Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment -> PM-YASASVI Top Class College Education Scheme
Fill profile, upload category and income documents
Institution verification officer verifies admission against the notified institute roster
Final state/ministry approval for direct benefit transfer (DBT)
source_title: PM-YASASVI Top Class Education Scheme for OBC, EBC and DNT Guidelines
source_excerpt: The Scheme is open to OBC, EBC and DNT students whose total family income from all sources does not exceed Rs. 2.50 lakh per annum. The scholarship will be awarded for study in notified Top Class Institutions (such as IITs, NITs, IIMs, Central Universities) for full time Degree/Diploma courses.
limitations: Restricted exclusively to students in notified premier institutions (approx. 250+ institutes nationally). General and SC/ST categories have separate dedicated schemes.

name: Telangana Overseas Vidya Nidhi
short_description: Financial grant of up to ₹20 Lakh plus one-way airfare for SC, ST, BC, and Minority graduates from Telangana pursuing Master's or Ph.D abroad.
administering_authority: Departments of BC, SC, ST and Minorities Welfare, Government of Telangana
income_rule_description: Gross family annual income from all sources shall not exceed ₹5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakh) per annum.
academic_requirements: Minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in graduation degree (Engineering, Management, Pure Sciences, Agriculture, Medicine, or Humanities). Valid TOEFL/IELTS and GRE/GMAT scores.
other_mandatory_criteria: Must be a domicile of Telangana State
Maximum age 35 years as of 1st July of the notification year
Admitted into an accredited foreign university in recognized countries (USA, UK, Australia, Canada, Singapore, Germany, etc.)
Only ONE child per family is eligible to receive this overseas grant
Valid Indian passport and student visa
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by Meeseva
Income Certificate from Meeseva (<= ₹5 Lakh p.a.)
SSC memo / Birth Certificate for proof of age (<= 35 years)
Degree Consolidated Marks Memo and Provisional Degree Certificate (min 60%)
Valid GRE / GMAT score card
Valid TOEFL / IELTS / PTE score card
Admission Offer Letter (I-20 / CAS) from accredited Foreign University
Valid Passport copy and Foreign Student Visa stamp
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details
application_steps: Apply online on Telangana ePASS portal under Overseas Vidya Nidhi link
Register with Meeseva Caste and Income application numbers
Upload graduation transcripts, foreign admission letter, visa, and test scorecards
Attend state screening committee interview with original credentials
Upon sanction, grant is disbursed in two installments linked to semester progression
source_title: Telangana Overseas Vidya Nidhi Scheme Rules (G.O.Ms.No.23 & Amendments)
source_excerpt: 1) Income: Family income shall not exceed Rs. 5.00 Lakhs per annum. 2) Age: Should not exceed 35 years as on 1st July. 3) Qualification: 60% marks in graduation degree. 4) One child per family. 5) Domicile of Telangana state pursuing Post Graduate / Ph.D courses in recognized foreign universities.
limitations: Only one candidate per family. Age limit strictly enforced. Foreign university must be in recognized list.
